llmJudgeRequirements.description: Reports are sourced from a Jotai async atom and include a refresh trigger read via `get`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: reportsAsyncAtom is defined with `atom(async (get) => ...)` and calls `get(refreshAtom)` to track the refresh trigger

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Implementation includes a helper that adapts an async atom using Jotai `unwrap` plus a derived `atom((get) => ...)` read function with try/catch error capture
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: reportsStateAtom uses a plain derived atom with instanceof Promise/Error checks; it does not use Jotai `unwrap` as required by the criterion
evidence: const reportsStateAtom = atom((get) => { const value = get(reportsAsyncAtom); if (value instanceof Promise) { ... } })

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Helper returns explicit loadable objects for loading data and error states (including payload for data/error), and UI branches directly on that returned state shape
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Helper returns explicit objects with loading/data/error fields; UI branches on state.loading, state.error, and renders FlatList when both are false
evidence: return { loading: true, data: null, error: null }
return { loading: false, data: null, error: value }
return { loading: false, data: value as Report[], error: null }

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Reload action updates the refresh trigger atom through `useSetAtom` or `useAtom` dispatch
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: handleReload calls setRefresh((s) => s + 1) where setRefresh is obtained via useSetAtom(refreshAtom), incrementing the refresh trigger atom
